messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix request: service `model-router-eu` -> prod-eu. Symptom: increased tail 502s after recent routing change. Owner: laura. Patch: revert connection pooling change and add conservative timeouts. Change window: immediate (10m prep). Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/model-router-hotfix

laura: TL;DR: saw 502 spikes on tails under burst. Revert applied in staging and passed load test. Requesting expedited deploy into prod; customer-facing impact in EU.

ben: Ack. Paste rollback steps and abort criteria so ops can stand by.

ops-lead: Rollback tested in staging:
```
kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/model-router router=registry.redwood/model-router:release-2026-03-10
kubectl rollout status deploy/model-router
```
Abort criteria: >1% 5xx for 5m OR p95 latency +300ms sustained. Approval policy: 2 engineer approvals + ops-lead consent.

anya: +1, will enable dashboards and take pager for 25m.

ben: +1 :thumbsup: I can monitor 5xx and p95.

deploy-bot: Approval flow: react with :thumbsup: to approve. Auto-start in 3m if 2 approvers (excluding deploy-bot).

anya: :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Approvals reached. Initiating canary rollout: image registry.redwood/model-router:hotfix-revert-2026-03-23 -> 5% traffic to canary pool. Health check /health expecting 200.

laura: Drafting release note: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/model-router-hotfix-2026-03-23 (RCA + rollback).

ops-lead: Monitoring. If errors spike >1% for 3m, abort and run rollback above.

anya: Canary metrics: 502s down from 2.8% -> 0.3% within 4m. p95 improved ~150ms.

ben: Observability green. Recommend bumping to 50% after 10m hold and keep pager pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 50%. Full rollout scheduled after a 20m stable window.

laura: Routing pin applied to prefer stable upstreams. Will update release note with final timing. Leaving thread open for post-rollout checks.

anya: Post-rollout check 25m: overall 502s at 0.2%, p95 within baseline. Ending pager watch in 5m. :tada:
